command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; if((git status --porcelain).Count -ne 0){throw 'Expected clean checkout'}; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'hc_toggle_probe.py'; @'

import ctypes as c
from ctypes import wintypes as w
import time

SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST=0x0042
SPI_SETHIGHCONTRAST=0x0043
HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON=0x00000001
SPIF_UPDATEINIFILE=0x0001
SPIF_SENDCHANGE=0x0002

class HIGHCONTRASTW(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[("cbSize",w.UINT),("dwFlags",w.DWORD),("lpszDefaultScheme",c.c_wchar_p)]

user32=c.windll.user32
user32.SystemParametersInfoW.argtypes=[w.UINT,w.UINT,c.c_void_p,w.UINT]
user32.SystemParametersInfoW.restype=w.BOOL

def get_state():
    buf=c.create_unicode_buffer(260)
    hc=HIGHCONTRASTW()
    hc.cbSize=c.sizeof(HIGHCONTRASTW)
    hc.lpszDefaultScheme=c.cast(buf,c.c_wchar_p)
    if not user32.SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST,c.sizeof(hc),c.byref(hc),0):
        raise OSError(c.get_last_error(),"SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST failed")
    return int(hc.dwFlags),buf.value

def set_state(flags,scheme):
    buf=c.create_unicode_buffer(scheme if scheme else "",260)
    hc=HIGHCONTRASTW()
    hc.cbSize=c.sizeof(HIGHCONTRASTW)
    hc.dwFlags=flags
    hc.lpszDefaultScheme=c.cast(buf,c.c_wchar_p)
    ok=user32.SystemParametersInfoW(
        SPI_SETHIGHCONTRAST,c.sizeof(hc),c.byref(hc),
        SPIF_UPDATEINIFILE|SPIF_SENDCHANGE)
    if not ok: raise OSError(c.get_last_error(),"SPI_SETHIGHCONTRAST failed")

orig_flags,orig_scheme=get_state()
print("HC_ORIGINAL_FLAGS",hex(orig_flags),"ON",bool(orig_flags&HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON),"SCHEME",repr(orig_scheme),flush=True)
restored=False
try:
    set_state(orig_flags|HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON,orig_scheme)
    time.sleep(2)
    flags,scheme=get_state()
    print("HC_AFTER_ENABLE_FLAGS",hex(flags),"ON",bool(flags&HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON),"SCHEME",repr(scheme),flush=True)
    if not (flags&HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON):
        raise AssertionError("High Contrast did not enable")
finally:
    set_state(orig_flags,orig_scheme)
    time.sleep(2)
    flags,scheme=get_state()
    restored=(flags==orig_flags)
    print("HC_RESTORED_FLAGS",hex(flags),"ON",bool(flags&HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON),"SCHEME",repr(scheme),"RESTORED",restored,flush=True)
if not restored:
    raise AssertionError("High Contrast original flags were not restored")

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
